objective: How to maximize adoption of a deterministic CLI for code review on GitHub
constraints: must be deterministic given a seed
must not depend on external APIs at install time

hypotheses.claim: An offline-first CLI raises first-week downloads by at least 2x compared to the SaaS alternative
evidence_for: no auth wall at install time
evidence_against: marketing of SaaS competitors is louder

hypotheses.claim: Promising the CLI solves any code-review problem maximizes downloads
evidence_against: trust erosion when first failed test occurs
scope risk: cannot cover all reviews
reviewer time wasted on false positives

hypotheses.claim: Focusing on a single, narrow reviewer persona (Rust crate maintainers) beats broad targeting
evidence_for: niche communities are dense and high-trust

metadata.science_origin: Diffusion of Innovations (Rogers, 1962); Christensen, The Innovator's Dilemma (1997)
